gate.label: Image adequate to judge this cell
gate.help: In focus, tissue present, no staining or fixation artefact over the cell. If No, the rest of the form is skipped and only notes are kept.

checklist.label: Crosshair sits on one identifiable cell
checklist.help: Not between cells, not on a clump where you cannot say which cell is meant.

checklist.label: Large cell
checklist.help: Roughly 3x or more the diameter of the small lymphocytes around it.

checklist.label: Multinucleated or multilobed nucleus
checklist.help: Two or more nuclei or lobes (DNA panel), e.g. a binucleate mirror-image form.

checklist.label: Prominent nucleolus
checklist.help: Large dark (DNA-poor) round hole inside the nucleus on the DNA panel.

checklist.label: Pale / vesicular chromatin
checklist.help: Nucleus paler and more even than its neighbours. Blur can mimic this; say No/Unsure if the field is soft.

checklist.label: CD45-negative or dim relative to neighbours
checklist.help: Judge against the cells touching it, not the whole field; CD45 sits on shared membranes in packed tissue.

checklist.label: Rosette of CD45-bright small lymphocytes
checklist.help: A ring of small CD45-bright cells hugging the cell. There is no CD3 stain on this slide, so this is a lymphocyte rosette, not a confirmed T-cell one.

confidence.label: Morphology consistent with an HRS cell
confidence.help: Morphology only: the defining HRS stains (CD30, CD15, PAX5, MUM1 protein) are not on this slide, so 5 means 'as HRS-like as these four stains can show'. Use the adequacy question, not 3, for images you cannot read.
